svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print standing on its back face (the face against the pack) so the four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: channels print as upright tunnels; 53 long, 88 wide, 31 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Channels 15 wide x 7 tall, centred 31.25 mm each side of the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5.4 mm above and below the motor axis height; open at both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lightening pocket underneath between the channels, open at the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inserts (M3, 5 mm): four in the back face (14 mm each side, 6 mm above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and below the axis) for the pack screws; four in the front face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (30 mm each side, 2.8 mm from the bottom and 2.5 mm from the top)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: back face flat on the pack front wall; channels line up with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pack's exit holes. Release plate and cover go on the front face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 15 x 7 mm gauge slides the full length of every channel.
